newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Radex jumps after strong 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Radex jumps after strong 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Radex-Heraklith, an Austrian manufacturer of fireproof materials, on Wednesday jumped in buoyant trade after the company reported a strong set of 1996 earnings.
By 0840 GMT, Radex was up 12.85 schillings, or 3.31 percent, at 401 and was by far the most actively traded in Vienna on turnover of over 22,000 shares.
Reporting preliminary 1996 group results, Radex said net profit surged 24 percent to 580 million schillings and pre-tax profit climbed 17 percent to 674 million.
"The results were better than expected," said one trader.
Analysts had been looking for a net profit of around 470 million. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
